title: Egg-shaped object descends in the Kilo area
place_text: Kilo area near Kilo 10, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I only saw one other thing in the kilo area and it was an object that looked like an egg that went straight to the ground

plain: In 1978, an object shaped like an egg dropped straight to the ground in the "Kilo" area, near a site called Kilo 10 in the nuclear missile field run from Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who served there, tells Michels he saw it himself, and says it was the only other thing he saw in that area. He brings a man named Mark Wade into the account. A sighting like this would put an unknown craft right beside American nuclear weapons.
